modelInfo.rawText: {"diagnosis":"Cart total uses stale LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) instead of the canonical catalog price from window.CATALOG, while displayed price correctly uses product.priceMinor.","evidenceSummary":"displayedPriceMatchesCatalog=true but cartTotalMatchesCatalog=false; catalog priceMinor=8900 and displayedPriceMinor=8900, yet quantity=2 gives cartTotalMinor=15800 (7900*2) instead of expectedTotalMinor=17800 (8900*2).","file":"app.js","old":"totalMinor = LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR * count;","new":"totalMinor = product.priceMinor * count;","rationale":"Derives cart unit price at runtime from product, which is looked up from window.CATALOG, without hardcoding 8900 or editing catalog.js, so cart total matches displayed/catalog price."}

repair.diagnosis: Cart total uses stale LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) instead of the canonical catalog price from window.CATALOG, while displayed price correctly uses product.priceMinor.
repair.evidenceSummary: displayedPriceMatchesCatalog=true but cartTotalMatchesCatalog=false; catalog priceMinor=8900 and displayedPriceMinor=8900, yet quantity=2 gives cartTotalMinor=15800 (7900*2) instead of expectedTotalMinor=17800 (8900*2).
repair.rationale: Derives cart unit price at runtime from product, which is looked up from window.CATALOG, without hardcoding 8900 or editing catalog.js, so cart total matches displayed/catalog price.
